svg.title: Balancing the forces on a traffic light
svg.desc: A 15.0-kilogram traffic light hangs from wires at 30 and 45 degrees. Tensions of 108 and 132 newtons are resolved into components; the horizontal components cancel at 93.2 newtons each and the vertical components add to the 147-newton weight. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Resolve each tension, then balance x and y separately
15.0-kg traffic light, wires at 30° and 45°. The horizontal parts cancel; the vertical parts add up
to the weight. Force arrows share one scale.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
